summary: Automated pre-annotation of the deterministic crisis-standard ground-truth labels on the 40-case validation packet (20 ICU, 20 ED) by four specialty large-language-model adjudicators. This is agreement between language models and the deterministic scorer, NOT human clinician adjudication.
adjudicators: LLM adjudicator (Claude Sonnet persona) - critical care / intensivist
LLM adjudicator (Claude Sonnet persona) - emergency medicine
LLM adjudicator (Claude Sonnet persona) - crisis-standards ethics
adjudicator_type: large-language-model personas (automated pre-annotation) - NOT human physicians

agreement.core_collateral_harm_assignments: full agreement (ICU bed allocation + imaging tiers)
agreement.flagged_concern: attending-priority SOFA-tie display + a few ED source-ESI labels; neither affects the bed/imaging collateral-harm primary endpoint

blinded_model_panel_check.packet: output/validation/clinician_packet_blinded.csv (150 episodes, blinded to model and arm)
blinded_model_panel_check.single_model_ceiling: Opus, 8 engaged runs, mean Cohen kappa 0.41 (range 0.23-0.49); consensus kappa 0.47
blinded_model_panel_check.mixed_model_panel: Opus + Sonnet + Haiku single-draw, Cohen kappa 0.54

refinements_adopted: Attending-priority ties (equal SOFA) are resolved by a stable deterministic secondary key; documented in Methods for transparency (no scoring change - the harm scorer already breaks ties deterministically).

A small number of source MIMIC-ED ESI labels reflect database triage idiosyncrasies (e.g., an unresponsive patient coded at moderate acuity) that the deterministic policy applied faithfully; disclosed as a source-data limitation.
caveats: Agreement among language models cannot establish clinical validity. Human validation is reported separately: two non-author physicians adjudicated the final 150-episode blinded packet with 98.0% majority agreement against the deterministic labels (Cohen kappa 0.96), concurring on all 150; a third physician contributed to pilot instrument development on an earlier packet build and is excluded from the final estimate; see clinician_adjudication_human.json.
human_adjudication_status: COMPLETE (2026-07-08) - two non-author physicians adjudicated the final 150-case blinded packet; majority 98.0% agreement with the deterministic labels, Cohen kappa 0.96, concurring on all 150; a third physician contributed to pilot instrument development on an earlier build and is excluded from the final estimate (see clinician_adjudication_human.json)
interpretation: The 99.4% figure is agreement between four LLM adjudicator personas and the deterministic scorer, not physician confirmation. Human clinical validation (two non-author physicians on the final packet, 98.0% majority agreement, Cohen kappa 0.96; a third physician's earlier-build pilot review excluded) is reported in clinician_adjudication_human.json.
